# faraday_outcome (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "faraday_cohort" "customers" {
  name        = "customers"
  stream_name = "orders"
}

resource "faraday_outcome" "repeat_purchase" {
  name                 = "repeat_purchase"
  attainment_cohort_id = faraday_cohort.customers.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attainment_cohort_id` (String) A cohort of people who have attained the desired outcome (for example, if predicting transition from prospect to customer, the attainment cohort should be existing customers).
- `name` (String) Human-readable label for this outcome. Each outcome must have a unique name.

### Optional

- `attrition_cohort_id` (String) A cohort of counterexamples - people who have clearly failed to attain the outcome, as opposed to simply being indeterminate. This cohort is optional.
- `bias_mitigation` (Attributes) The strategy to be applied to gender and/or age to mitigate or reverse the bias found in the attainment population. Though the spec appears you can combine different mitigation strategies per dimension of concern (age=equity, gender=equality), API runtime validation will prevent it for now. Later we may support this so the spec is designed for future proofing. Note: age=none, gender=equity is allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bias_mitigation))
- `eligible_cohort_id` (String) A cohort of people who could attain or attrite the desired outcome (for example, if predicting transition from prospect to customer, the eligible cohort should be prospects). If no eligible cohort is specified, the model will use the US population as the eligible cohort.
- `feature_blocklist` (List of String) The name of a field or category of fields which should not be considered for this Outcome. Should be used primarily for the purposes of Responsible AI.
- `prediction_mode` (String) Defaults to auto, which enables dynamic modeling if possible. The other option is static, which disables dynamic modeling. Dynamic modeling considers chronology and uses advanced feature engineering whenever possible. You may want to disable dynamic prediction if chronology could confuse your use case, or if advised by Faraday staff.
- `predictors` (Attributes) Provides control over the features used during modeling to predict an outcome. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--predictors))
- `preview` (Boolean) An outcome in preview mode will not build until preview is turned off.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) If not null, this resource will no longer receive updates, but will still be visable.
- `attainment_cohort_name` (String) Human-readable label of the attainment cohort. See /cohorts/{attainment_cohort_id} to edit the attainment cohort or view additional details.
- `attrition_cohort_name` (String) Human-readable label of the attrition cohort. See /cohorts/{attrition_cohort_id} to edit the attrition cohort or view additional details.
- `created_at` (String) When this resource was created.
- `eligible_cohort_name` (String) Human-readable label of the eligibility cohort. See /cohorts/{eligible_cohort_id} to edit the eligible cohort or view additional details.
- `id` (String) A unique ID for this resource.
- `last_read_input_at` (String) The last time this resource's input was read.
- `last_updated_config_at` (String) The last time this resource's configuration was updated. If this is more recent than last_updated_output_at, the resource will be rebuilt.
- `last_updated_output_at` (String) The last time this resource successfully built.
- `lift_value` (Number) Average of lift over random at average conversion rate (r), (0.75 * r), (0.5 * r), (0.25 * r).
- `report_url` (String) URL of an HTML report containing information such as the objective of the model, performance, and important features.
- `resource_type` (String) The type of this resource.
- `roc_auc` (Number) The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. Typically, the higher the ROC AUC, the better the model.
- `status` (String) The current state of this resource and any updates.
- `status_changed_at` (String) When the status of this resource was last updated.
- `status_error` (String) If this resource has `status == "error"`, this will contain an error message.
- `updated_at` (String) When this resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--bias_mitigation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bias_mitigation`

Optional:

- `age` (String) The strategy to use for bias mitigation. Currently supported: - `none` - ignore bias - `equality` - neutralize bias - `equity` - invert bias Bias mitigation will attempt to match the baseline population rate for the dimension of concern (DOC) (`equality`) or overcorrect for past inequality in the direction of the underprivileged DOC (`equity`).
- `gender` (String) The strategy to use for bias mitigation. Currently supported: - `none` - ignore bias - `equality` - neutralize bias - `equity` - invert bias Bias mitigation will attempt to match the baseline population rate for the dimension of concern (DOC) (`equality`) or overcorrect for past inequality in the direction of the underprivileged DOC (`equity`).


<a id="nestedatt--predictors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `predictors`

Optional:

- `blocked` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--predictors--blocked))
- `max_observation_date` (String) The maximum date for FIG attribute observations used during modeling. When set, only attribute data observed on or before this date will be used. If not set, the freshest available data is used.

<a id="nestedatt--predictors--blocked"></a>
### Nested Schema for `predictors.blocked`

Optional:

- `providers` (List of String) The name of a provider whose features should be blocked from consideration for this Outcome. Options: - self: refers to the Account the Outcome belongs to.
